name: Sales Rep Activity
query:
SELECT
  ur.user AS `Sales Rep:Link/User:220`,
  IFNULL(SUM(v.visit_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY)), 0) AS `This Month:Int:110`,
  COUNT(v.name) AS `Total Visits:Int:110`,
  IFNULL(SUM(v.visit_outcome = 'Positive'), 0) AS `Positive:Int:90`,
  IFNULL(SUM(v.order_expected = 1), 0) AS `Orders Expected:Int:130`,
  MAX(v.visit_date) AS `Last Visit:Date:110`
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT parent AS user FROM `tabHas Role`
      WHERE role = 'Sales Rep' AND parenttype = 'User') ur
JOIN `tabUser` u ON u.name = ur.user AND u.enabled = 1
LEFT JOIN `tabKC Visit` v ON v.sales_rep = ur.user
GROUP BY ur.user
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC
